focusedTests.command: focused production Playwright Chromium and Firefox interaction specs

observations: The inspected desktop light render with statusDensity none contains no footer, separator, empty shell, or extra metrics accessibility node.
The inspected minimal light and 200 percent zoom dark renders retain one restrained status line with exactly two metrics and preserve the editor as the primary surface.

The inspected 375px long-locale detailed render uses a compact definition list whose full labels wrap without shrinking to 10 or 11px, turning into badges, or reducing the editor body to an unusable area.
The inspected 375px RTL dark render preserves RTL content and toolbar order while keeping the detailed metrics readable without horizontal overflow.

The five inspected accessibility trees each expose one editor region and one textbox; detailed metrics occur once as term-definition pairs, minimal metrics occur once as text, and none exposes no metrics representation.

limitations: Rendered evidence was inspected from deterministic local production fixtures; no physical assistive-technology session is claimed.
The two skipped Playwright cases are evidence-gated issue-395 tests outside the #272 dependency chain.
